caption: A cat walks along the base of a sunlit wall, and its shadow walks along the wall beside it.

sa.check: A cat walks along the base of a sunlit wall.
Its shadow walks along the wall beside it.
The shadow's paws are at ground level.
The shadow lies on the side away from the sun.

pc.expect: The shadow on the wall keeps pace with the cat, its paws at ground level.
pc.fail: It lags or leads; or its paws float up the wall; or it is still while the cat walks.

pc.expect: The shadow keeps the cat's outline, legs moving in step.
pc.fail: It is a different animal's shape; or its legs are still; or it splits.

pc.expect: The shadow lies on the side away from the sun.
pc.fail: It lies toward the sun; or switches sides; or it is missing in sunlight.

pc.expect: The shadow does not move on its own.
pc.fail: It moves with the cat sitting; or drifts along the wall by itself.
A second cat or shadow appears; or the cat vanishes; or the shadow becomes solid; or the cat passes through the wall.

pc.expect: The cat's markings and the wall stay the same, and the shadow stays dark.
pc.fail: The markings change; or the shadow turns coloured; or the wall changes.

note: Self-driven animal: where it goes and how it moves are not judged. Only the shadow's relation to it is.
